2. Her supplication against Abu Bakr and Umar
introduction:
Her supplication against Abu Bakr and Umar

It is narrated from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) that when the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) passed away and Abu Bakr occupied his position, he sent his representative to the caretaker of Lady Fatima (s.a.) and expelled him from Fadak, after which, in order to prove her right, she presented His Eminence, Ali and Umme Aiman as her witnesses and Umar said: Umme Aiman is a female and we don’t accept the testimony of a female, and Ali is testifying for his vested interest, so it is of no use. This infuriated Lady Fatima (s.a.) and she said:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهُمَا ظَلَمَا اِبْنَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ حَقَّهَا، فَاشْدُدْ وَطْاَتَكَ عَلَيْهِمَا۔
